title: The Loose Lamp
who: young keeper on the tender's arm
want: Bring a loose kept lamp in to the keepers' tender without a hand on it while it is lit.
at_stake: The lamp's loop is lost, and the keepers hold the loss against your hull at the next tender round.
complication: A lamp dressed as a wreck beacon whose loop breathes. (complications.md, salvage 4)

approaches.label: Net the lamp with the tender's line
approaches.npc_reaction: watches the line, not the lamp

approaches.label: Wait out the loop and cut its carrier
approaches.npc_reaction: holds her breath with the lamp

approaches.label: Ask the keeper to cut it free
approaches.npc_reaction: will not let a stranger touch it

Net the lamp with the tender's line.clean: the keepers pay your crew a salvage fee for the lamp brought in whole
Net the lamp with the tender's line.cost: the housing cracks in the net and your crew pays for the repair
Net the lamp with the tender's line.fail: the line fouls and the keepers count the lost loop against your hull, a fee your crew pays

Wait out the loop and cut its carrier.clean: the keepers speak of your crew's patience at the next marker
Wait out the loop and cut its carrier.cost: the keepers take a fee for the lit lamp your crew worked too close to
Wait out the loop and cut its carrier.fail: your crew pays the tender for a ruined carrier

Ask the keeper to cut it free.clean: the keeper's steady hand settles the tender and it pays your crew for the quiet recovery
Ask the keeper to cut it free.cost: your crew pays the tender for the keeper's time and the lost hour
Ask the keeper to cut it free.fail: your crew pays a fee because the keeper's hand was late

sensory_details_used.light: lamps hanging like a slow constellation
sensory_details_used.temperature: a flask warm through its wrapping
